scope: Shared context/mixer lifecycle checks with native music/worklets and controlled completion/failure observation; no official-equivalence claim
reproduced: An obsolete ensureAudioSessionReady context/mixer failure still executes stopMusic and switches replacement playback to HTML media. Native before evidence shows both boundaries clear the new AudioBufferSource and move music time from 0.303299... to 0.
After reset and native AudioContext replacement, a late completed native AudioWorklet mixer overwrites the active mixer with one from the closed context and is not disconnected.
An obsolete mixer finally clears the newer pending factory. The native before pending scenario then starts a third factory instead of sharing the second.
changes: Check the engine transition/running state before context preparation, after each asynchronous boundary, and before error fallback. Current failures retain the existing fallback behavior.
Associate a pending mixer factory with its AudioContext and promise identity. Only its active owner may publish, report a fallback or clear pending state.
Disconnect a discarded completed mixer and return null to obsolete callers; never return or register samples into a mixer from another context.
Preserve current same-context factory sharing, sample deduplication/reset/flush, current-error retry and all existing judgment/assets/import/save behavior.

browserMethod: Real Chromium AudioContext, original PhiHitAudioMixer.create/AudioWorkletNode and decoded Leave All Behind EZ music run. Delay native factory completion observation, reset the shared context through the shipped method, then test ready/pending replacements. Separately inject an obsolete error after native context/mixer preparation completes, using original resume/countdown/restart paths. These are controlled fault/ordering tests, not naturally observed native failures, network frequency, device output or Safari measurements.
browserOutcomes: Before: both obsolete session failures remove the replacement source and switch transport; both mixer scenarios lose ownership, with three creations in the pending case.

After: both session failures retain the actual new AudioBufferSource, Web Audio mode and advancing clock; both native mixer scenarios retain the new promise/mixer, create only two factories, return null for old calls and disconnect the old mixer once.
No browser pageErrors in either before or after evidence. Pending mixer=null before publication is intentional, not a missing final mixer.
limitations: Faults and completion delays are injected around actual operations; no claim that this records organic browser/Safari failure frequency.
No physical audio output/latency, real iPad Safari, real-user save or official audiovisual/judgment equivalence measurement.
Other asynchronous resource preparation, first-play activation and device/context interruption combinations are not exhausted by these tests.
Unique official baseline/settings/resources and complete visual/animation/Tips/chapter/replay acceptance remain blocked or unverified as recorded in docs/fidelity-acceptance.json.
